description: DOM clobbering vectors. The sanitizer neutralizes clobbering by prefixing id/name values with user-content- and stripping disallowed elements. Structural: form/iframe/embed/object are gone, no javascript: URL survives. Raw clobbering values (name="location", id="x", ...) must not appear because prefixing inserts user-content-. Legitimate input/name/img elements survive with prefixed values.
